Automation.Description: Pre-processing automation that sets the ResolveCustomerContent field with formatted content text

Source.Value:
What to Build

Your app must handle POST requests at your FulfillmentUrl. When AWS redirects a new subscriber there, the request includes x-amzn-marketplace-token in the POST body.

Your Handler Must:

  1. Extract the token from the POST body
  2. Call ResolveCustomer with that token
  3. Store CustomerIdentifier in your database
  4. Show the buyer a registration/welcome page

Example (Node.js/Express)

import { MarketplaceMeteringClient, ResolveCustomerCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-marketplace-metering';
const metering = new MarketplaceMeteringClient({ region: 'us-east-1' });

app.post('/marketplace/register', async (req, res) => {
  const token = req.body['x-amzn-marketplace-token'];
  const { CustomerIdentifier, CustomerAWSAccountId } = await metering.send(
    new ResolveCustomerCommand({ RegistrationToken: token })
  );
  await db.users.update({ marketplaceCustomerId: CustomerIdentifier });
  res.redirect('/dashboard?welcome=true');
});

Important: You must call ResolveCustomer within 5 minutes of receiving the token, or it expires.

Required IAM Policies

Create an IAM user (long-lived access keys) and attach the following policies:

  • AWSMarketplaceSellerFullAccess
  • aws-marketplace:StartChangeSet — explicit allow
  • aws-marketplace:ResolveCustomer — explicit allow

Generate Access Keys

In the IAM console, create an access key for the user. You will get an Access Key ID (starts with AKIA) and a Secret Access Key.

Enter Credentials in Configuration Settings

An application administrator must enter these values into the AWS Marketplace Credentials configuration set (in Studio):

  • AWS Access Key — the AKIA... value
  • AWS Secret Key — the secret access key
  • AWS Region — already set to us-east-1

The application reads these at runtime to call the AWS Marketplace Catalog API. You cannot continue past this step until the Access Key and Secret Key are configured.

⚠ Do not paste credentials into case fields, source code, or notes. Only enter them in the configuration set.

Automation.Description: Pre-processing automation that sets the BatchMeterUsageContent field with formatted content text

Source.Value:
What to Build

Set up a cron job or scheduled Lambda that runs hourly. Each record needs:

  • CustomerIdentifier (from ResolveCustomer, stored in your DB)
  • Dimension key (must match keys defined in your pricing)
  • Quantity (integer — usage for that hour)
  • Timestamp (ISO 8601, within the last 1 hour)

Handle CustomerNotSubscribed by revoking access.

Example (Node.js)

import { MarketplaceMeteringClient, BatchMeterUsageCommand } from '@aws-sdk/client-marketplace-metering';
const metering = new MarketplaceMeteringClient({ region: 'us-east-1' });

async function sendHourlyUsage(subscribers) {
  const records = subscribers.map(s => ({
    CustomerIdentifier: s.marketplaceCustomerId,
    Dimension: 'api_calls',
    Quantity: s.usageThisHour,
    Timestamp: new Date(),
  }));
  const { Results } = await metering.send(
    new BatchMeterUsageCommand({ ProductCode: '<your-product-code>', UsageRecords: records })
  );
  for (const r of Results) {
    if (r.Status === 'CustomerNotSubscribed')
      await db.users.revokeAccess(r.UsageRecord.CustomerIdentifier);
  }
}

Verify: Records should appear in AWS Marketplace Management Portal → Reports → Metering

Add 3 to 5 short phrases that describe what makes your product stand out. These appear as bullet points on your AWS Marketplace listing and are the first thing buyers read. Keep each one to a single sentence focused on benefits, not features.

e.g. Real-time fraud detection with sub-second response times

1. Approved (or Passed)

- Description: The listing has been approved by AWS and is successfully published to the live, public AWS Marketplace.

2. Changes Requested (or Action Required)

- Description: AWS reviewers have identified issues (e.g., logo formatting, broken URLs, missing support terms) and sent the listing back to the seller with specific feedback for corrections.

3. Rejected (or Failed)

- Description: The listing has been rejected and cannot be published in its current form.
